nome: inemaSEO 6 — Professional: selling and delivering SEO + AI as a service people can trust

lado_card.texto: To deliver with open tools, course 7 teaches you to set up the auditor, the Search Console history, the robot reader and the readiness score on your own computer.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · Professional 2030 · inemaSEO method (MIT) · inema.club

inicio.titulo: Professional: selling and delivering SEO + AI as a service people can trust
inicio.lead: Building got easy; trusting what was built did not. In eight lessons you learn to sell diagnosis, plan, measured follow-up and teaching, instead of position 1 or 500 articles. Diagnosis, 30/90/180 plan, proposal with limits, delivery with agents, monthly report, written authorization and an offer ladder.
inicio.capa_alt: A consultant shows a one-page report to a small business owner at a simple meeting table.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work with a client: what to sell, diagnose, plan, propose, deliver, report, protect and prospect.

itens: Freelancers, agencies or consultants who want to sell SEO and AI visibility without promising what no one controls.
People who have taken the site-owner courses (or know the equivalent) and now want to look after other people's sites.
People who lose bids to those who promise "first place in 30 days" and want an offer that still holds up in month 6.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: A 1-page diagnosis: delivered HTML, AI readiness and neutral questions in the AIs.
A 30/90/180-day plan by impact × effort and a proposal with scope, limits and prerequisites.
A folder per client with human gates and a monthly report that counts down to zero.
The written authorization, the list of what you turn down and an offer ladder with 10 prospects.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation, 2 Content and 3 Measurement: the site owner builds the base, the pages only they can write, and measures the non-branded number.
4 In the AIs and 5 With Agents: official AI dashboards and agents doing the repetitive work with gates.
6 Professional (this course): the same method sold and delivered as a service people can trust. 7 Systems: the open tools to deliver with.
The vision comes from Professional 2030; the selling itself, from the Selling with AI Program.
